slides.heading: Get it checked promptly if

caption:
Can't lie on your side without your hip complaining?

Pain on the outside of the hip that's tender to touch and worse lying on it or climbing stairs is often linked to the gluteal tendons. It's common from middle age, and it usually responds well to changing how the tendons are loaded.

Tonight, try sleeping on the other side with a pillow between your knees. During the day, skip crossing your legs and hitching onto one hip. Current guidelines favour progressive strengthening built up over a few months.

Pain after a fall, a worsening limp or fever should be checked promptly. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
